// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul baseline (256x256x512).
void solution(void) {
  gemmini_flush(0);

  int tiles_I = BLK / DIM, tiles_J = BLK / DIM, tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;
  uint32_t a_base = 0;
  uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles_J * tiles_K * DIM;
  int SPAD_DEST = 128;

  // Swap the loop order: N-dimension (j0) is now outer, enabling reuse of weights (B)
  for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
    // Partial last N block: compute only the real cols, pad the rest.
    int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK; if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK; if (ncols <= 0) continue;

    // PROF cpu_stage (B scales)
    // Stage B scales only once per outer j0 block
    int gk_groups = (MATMUL_K + 31) / 32; // Assuming 32 is the scale group size
    for (int g = 0; g < gk_groups; g++) {
      int copy_len = (ncols > BLK) ? BLK : ncols;
      if (copy_len > 0) {
        memcpy(&B_s[g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK], copy_len);
      }
    }

    // Load B scales and B data once per j0 column block
    gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_s, gk_groups * BLK, 1);

    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t));      // B rows: stride N
    for (int j = 0; j < tiles_J; j++)                  // B[k][j0*BLK+j] -> slot (k*tiles_J + j)
      for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
        gemmini_extended_mvin2((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
                               b_base + (j * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);

    // Inner loop over M-dimension (i0) reuses the static B tiles loaded in the scratchpad
    for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
      int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK; if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK; if (mrows <= 0) continue;

      // PROF cpu_stage (A scales)
      for (int g = 0; g < gk_groups; g++) {
        int copy_len = (mrows > BLK) ? BLK : mrows;
        if (copy_len > 0) {
          memcpy(&A_s[g][0], &A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK], copy_len);
        }
      }

      int pad_i = BLK - mrows, pad_j = BLK - ncols;

      // Load A scales and A data
      gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_s, gk_groups * BLK, 0);

      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));      // A rows: stride K (full block-aligned tiles)
      for (int i = 0; i < tiles_I; i++)
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
                                a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);

      gemmini_config_st(BLK_OUTC * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, 0, 1, 1);

      // Perform computation (fused loop) utilizing B already in scratchpad
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, pad_i, pad_j, 0, a_base, b_base, 0,
                           SPAD_DEST, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // Read back results
      int bf16_ncols = (ncols + 1) / 2; // BF16 packing: 2 values per word
      for (int r = 0; r < mrows; r++)
        gemmini_mx_read_smem(&C_hw[i0 * BLK + r][j0 * BLK / 2],
                             SPAD_DEST * 16 + r * BLK, ncols);
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }
}
